# `liber:printer-device@1`

Generated reference for the `liber:printer-device` package (`printer-device.lsidl`). See [the LSIDL language](../../../LSIDL.md).

LiberSystem printers - the private backend contract a `printer` publication serves to SpoolService.  A BACKEND MOVES BYTES AND REPORTS THE PORT; THE SERVICE OWNS EVERYTHING ELSE. The USB printer class module, and the kernel test sink before it, attach under a version and an attachment generation, report the IEEE 1284 device ID and the port status byte, and accept a prefix of each write. Admission, ordering, deadlines, reset and recovery are SpoolService's; there is no arbitrary control request.

## Interfaces

### interface `printer-backend`

THE BACKEND CONTRACT a `printer` publication serves - to SpoolService alone. One write outstanding at a time, at most 4096 bytes; the answer is how many bytes of its PREFIX were accepted, or `again` for none.

Request `[op u16][corr u32][args]`, reply `[corr u32][result]`.

| op | method | signature | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `attach` | `attach(version: u32) -> result<printer-attach, error>` |  |
| 2 | `port-status` | `port-status(attachment: u64) -> result<port-reading, error>` |  |
| 3 | `write` | `write(attachment: u64, bytes: list<u8>) -> result<u32, error>` |  |
| 4 | `reset` | `reset(attachment: u64) -> result<printer-attach, error>` | Reset the port. A new attachment generation on success; the attachment is gone either way. |
